the majority of participants (81.6%) viewed their test reports before their post-test genomic counseling sessions and that the majority of these participants (81.8%, n = 36) requested assessment of additional medical/family histories.

a post-test genomic testing framework is an acceptable and feasible model of care for patients with chronic disease and that the post-test counseling framework can be used to provide tailored counseling to patients with varying disease and drug response test results, and to provide counseling to patients with multiple disease and drug response results.

this study demonstrated the feasibility of a post-test genetic counseling service delivery framework that allows for the scalable delivery of precision health.

patients’ preferences for post-test genomic counseling can be captured in advance and used to guide the development and delivery of a scalable post-test genomic counseling service.
